name: Don Guttridge
occupation: Home designer; farmer; Clackamas SWCD Director

bio.statement: Guttridge's pamphlet statement lists prior governmental experience as USMC Reserves for 13 years and Clackamas SWCD board member.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: USMC Reserves; 13 years, Honorable Discharge 06/09/1990; Clackamas Soil & Water Conservation District; Board of Directors

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 59 (printed C-58)

bio.statement: Guttridge's pamphlet statement says Guttridge was raised on a Century Farm (1874) and has operated a portion of it for 34 years.
bio.excerpt: I have been raised on a Century Farm (1874), and operated a portion of that same farm for the past 34 years with my wife and daughters.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 59 (printed C-58)

bio.statement: The district's board page lists Guttridge as Zone 5 director and chair, term expiring in 2026.
bio.excerpt: 5 Don Guttridge Biography Chair 2026 Estacada and central/east Clackamas County

source.publisher: Clackamas Soil and Water Conservation District (official site), Our People

verification.note: Excerpt was a bare name; replaced with the board table row (zone, name, role, term) that supports the statement.

positions.statement: Guttridge's pamphlet statement says the district works one on one to help conserve soil and clean water without regulatory or enforcement mandates.
positions.excerpt: The District works one on one to help conserve soil and clean water without any regulatory or enforcement mandates.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 59 (printed C-58)

positions.statement: Guttridge's pamphlet statement calls conservation and wise use of natural resources a way of life and describes serving on the district board as giving back.
positions.excerpt: Conservation and wise-use of natural resources is a way of life that I am proud to be involved in, serving on the Board of the Clackamas Soil and Water Conservation District is merely “giving-back” to the community I live in.

source.publisher: Clackamas County Elections, Official Voters' Pamphlet (Nov 3, 2026), PDF p. 59 (printed C-58)
